summary.headline: Prestige Estates Q2 FY27 residential sales rose 20% YoY to ₹7,225 crore; management reiterates ₹36,000 crore H2 launch-led sales target.
summary.overview: Management reported a strong first half FY27 with Q2 residential sales of ₹7,225 crore (up 20% YoY) on 5.84 million sq ft and 3,910 units, taking H1 sales to ₹13,804 crore. Q2 revenue from operations was ₹2,222 crore with EBITDA of ₹1,088 crore and PAT of ₹256 crore, and operating cash flow was ₹2,670 crore. The CPP Investment hospitality platform deal has received ₹1,500 crore so far, with a further ₹1,500 crore in two tranches. Management guided H2 launches of over ₹45,000 crore across Bengaluru, Mumbai, NCR, Chennai, Goa and Hyderabad, with the first five launches (including Falcon City Thane) expected in Q3 subject to RERA approvals.

segments.name: Residential
segments.commentary: Q2 sales ₹7,225 crore, 20% YoY growth; Bengaluru 41%, Hyderabad 32%, Mumbai 12%, Chennai 8%, others 7%. Launched 3 projects in Q2 (5.91 mn sq ft, GDV ~₹4,020 crore); H1 launches 23.14 mn sq ft, GDV over ₹16,200 crore. Completed 4.27 mn sq ft in Q2, 5 mn sq ft in H1.

segments.name: Office
segments.commentary: Leasing of 1.7 mn sq ft in H1; started construction on three commercial projects (2 mn sq ft) in Chennai and Kochi in Q2. Completed Aero City Delhi (800,000 sq ft). VKC X about 1.5 mn sq ft pre-leased; Mahalaxmi about 0.4 mn sq ft leased.

segments.name: Retail
segments.commentary: Mall tenant sales ₹721 crore in Q2 (+10% YoY); footfalls 5.2 mn; occupancy 99%. Acquired a near-complete mall (Forum South, ~130,000 sq ft usable, est. ~₹13 crore monthly bottom line) expected to open in 9–12 months after interiors and tenanting.

segments.name: Hospitality
segments.commentary: H1 occupancy 70%, average room rate ₹15,143. Started construction on JW Marriott and MOXY OMR in Chennai (313 keys, 0.77 mn sq ft). Dial hotel handover to operator by end-November 2026. CPP Investment committed ₹3,000 crore for ~20% of Wethere Hospitality Ventures; ₹1,500 crore received in October 2026.

segments.name: Property management
segments.commentary: Revenue of ₹450 crore and EBIT of ₹51 crore reported for the segment (as stated on the call).

guidance_outlook: FY27 residential sales bookings guidance of ₹36,000 crore retained; management said it does not want to over-promise.
H2 FY27 launch pipeline above ₹45,000 crore (~46,500 crore cited in Q&A); at least ₹20,000 crore expected in Q3 FY27.
FY27 construction spend guided at ₹10,000–11,000 crore, with H2 somewhat higher due to large launches.
FY27 gross collections guided at ₹24,000–25,000 crore; operating cash flow ~₹9,000 crore; free cash flow ~₹9,000 crore (as stated).
Business development spend guided at ₹4,500–5,000 crore for FY27.
CPP balance ₹1,500 crore expected in two tranches of ₹750 crore over 1–2 years; attributable stake to rise from ~16% to ~27% after both tranches.
Pending hotel capex estimated around ₹5,000 crore; stabilised hotel revenue to be provided later.
capex_capacity: Launch pipeline next two quarters: Falcon City Thane (phase 1; approval received two days before call, CC and RERA pending), Prestige Bogle Garden (Noida), Prestige Avon and Stringwood (Bengaluru), Prestige Caves (Goa); then Chamber 51, Sarjapur City Reserve, Prestige Medows, plus Chennai and Hyderabad projects.
Dial hotel (Mumbai) ready for occupancy; key handover to operator by end-Nov 2026; soft launch about 3–4 weeks later.
Rent at Dial office expected to be fully yielding by April 2027 after free period.
VKC X and Mahalaxmi office assets expected completed by end-FY27 (per management).
demand_pricing: Management said demand for quality, well-priced product remains strong; focus on Bengaluru, Hyderabad, Chennai, NCR and MMR (MMR ticket size of ₹2 crore and above).
Hyderabad described as strong but facing future supply pressure from SSI policy; Prestige Bogle Garden (Hyderabad) sold out quickly with no nearby competition.
Pre-sales from Precity City (Rajapur) about 90% sold, as cited by management.
Sales push in Q2 was a general sustained-sales effort; management said it does not use schemes.

qa_highlights.question: When will the balance CPP Investment capital arrive and how will the stake change?
qa_highlights.answer: ₹1,500 crore received so far (₹950 crore secondary, ₹550 crore primary); remaining ₹1,500 crore in two tranches of ₹750 crore over 1–2 years. Attributable stake rises from ~16% to ~27%.

qa_highlights.question: Is the ₹36,000 crore FY27 target conservative given ₹13,800 crore H1 and ₹46,500 crore launches?
qa_highlights.answer: Management said it does not want to over-promise; upside possible if approvals come through. FY28 guidance to be discussed after year-end.

qa_highlights.question: Why were exit rental estimates lowered for FY28/FY29 and raised for FY31?
qa_highlights.answer: Some upcoming projects had approval delays and revised completion timelines; ongoing portfolio unchanged. FY31 increase due to a Hyderabad Raidurg land project (~₹250 crore plus) moved into the upcoming portfolio.

qa_highlights.question: Falcon City Thane initial response and timing of phase 2?
qa_highlights.answer: Survey response described as phenomenal but management will wait for RERA and bookings; phase 2 depends on phase 1 sales, possibly FY28 or FY29.

qa_highlights.question: Q3 versus Q4 launch split for H2 pipeline?
qa_highlights.answer: Five projects (Noida, two Bengaluru, Goa and one more) expected in Q3 if RERA approvals come through; Chamber 51 office in Q3, Chamber 51 residential and Meadows likely in Q4.

qa_highlights.question: What is the Forum South mall acquisition and when will it open?
qa_highlights.answer: Acquired through NCLT process from a fund; buildings and occupancy certificate in place; 9–12 months needed for interiors and tenanting. Expected monthly bottom line ~₹13 crore.

qa_highlights.question: Outlook for mid vs entry segments, MMR and business development spend?
qa_highlights.answer: Mid to upper-mid segment seen as evergreen; MMR focus ₹2 crore+ ticket. BD spend described as continuous; cash-flow-led, with land pipeline available.

risks_watch: Launch timing depends on RERA and CC approvals; a slip would push ₹36,000 crore sales target risk.
Hyderabad supply overhang from SSI policy; some peers' launches reported as unsuccessful.
Delays in approvals for upcoming office and hotel projects affecting exit rental timing.
Off-balance-sheet JV debt of about ₹2,400 crore (Prestige share).
Forum South mall ramp-up timeline of 9–12 months; hotel stabilisation dependent on operator.
summary.management_tone: Confident on residential demand and launch pipeline, but cautious on FY27 sales guidance and on timing, stating approvals still pending. Management was specific on cash flow guidance and CPP deal mechanics, and deferred some questions (FY28 outlook, hotel capex, acquisition price) to offline follow-up.

rows.label: New product launch
